node.statement: Assume epsilon=0 and apply the correction in 1.1 indefinitely. Then d_{j+1}<=K d_j^2<=d_j/4, so d_j<=4^{-j}d. Hence for k>j, sup_n||v_{k,n}-v_{j,n}||<=K sum_{r=j}^{k-1}d_r<=K d 4^{-j}/(1-1/4), which tends to zero uniformly in n. Completeness of A at level one and finite dimensionality of B therefore give an operator-norm limit linear map v_tilde:B->A; for each n its amplification is the limit of v_{j,n}=I_n tensor v_j, and the same tail estimate yields sup_n||v_tilde_n-v_n||<=K sum_{j>=0}d_j<=4K d/3<=K_disp d.
